dataset: shared data/train.csv LJ/DiffSSD sample: 726 clips (242 real, 484 synthetic)
validation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold; random_state=2026; speaker and generator groups held out; identical folds for all methods
blend_weights: fixed 50/50; no weight or threshold tuning on these validation labels
notes: The Julia branch adds a small score adjustment for structurally consistent metadata. Its acoustic random forest uses the same feature and model family as Arshiya.
The Arshiya temporal model is weaker alone but improves minDCF in a fixed equal-weight blend on these grouped OOF scores.
This is a shared LJ/DiffSSD sample, not the larger Julia training manifest or the hidden challenge test set. Treat the small gains as provisional.
OOF scores were generated from the same five group folds; the Julia metadata analysis and adjustment came from origin/julia commit e0cf46f.
